# calm-design — calmtiger86

**Repo:** https://github.com/calmtiger86/calm-design · **Install:** git clone into `.claude/skills/calm-design`.
**In the set:** 1 tool — `calm-design` (94 lines + a large `references/` tree).

## What it is

A full-stack "calm premium" design agent: writes a `DESIGN.md`, then runs visual self-critique and a
pre-flight check. Korean-first — its description and prompts are in Korean and it may answer in
Korean unless told otherwise.

## The contract

Orchestrator-class: own context. Expect it to produce a `DESIGN.md`; on a YOURSAUNAS surface the
brand contract outranks that file.

## Engage

- Direct only: `/design-tools:calm-design <target>`.
